entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A dragon-mage planeswalker who changed Tarkir's past, now an 'orphan of time' who learns from Ugin that his home timeline never existed and reunites with this world's Narset.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The luminous spirit dragon planeswalker, now awake after a thousand years, who surmises from the hedron shard what Sarkhan did.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: This timeline's Narset, a Planeswalker branded a heretic by Ojutai, who has traveled beyond Tarkir and knows of Sarkhan from secret histories.

entities.name: Zurgo
entities.description: A Mardu orc who is now a stooped bell-ringer following a dragon, remembered by Sarkhan as his hated enemy.

entities.name: Ankle Shanker
entities.description: A goblin who lived instead of dying and has a different name and life, and doesn't know Sarkhan.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An ancient dragon planeswalker obsessed with regaining power, who sent Sarkhan to open the Eye and release the Eldrazi, and who attacked Ugin.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker and ally of Ugin who woke him from slumber and told him of 'foolishness at the Eye'.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: The Jeskai dragonlord whose monks tell Sarkhan that Narset is gone.

entities.name: Kolaghan
entities.description: The dragon followed by a horde of savage warriors across the steppe.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: The dragonlord of Atarka lands, where Narset hopes to find ancient ivory stories of the Khanfall.

entities.name: Pyromancer
entities.description: A planeswalker who fought Sarkhan at the Eye of Ugin and defeated him with Ugin's own fire.

entities.name: Mind mage
entities.description: A planeswalker who fought Sarkhan at the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: World-devouring beings Bolas wanted released from the Eye.

entities.name: Spirit guardians
entities.description: Luminous ghostly dragons that guard Ugin and harry Sarkhan before being called off.

entities.name: Ugin's canyon
entities.description: The canyon where Ugin's hedron cocoon lay, now filled with rune-etched rubble.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: The Zendikar chamber from which Sarkhan took a hedron shard.

entities.name: Hedron shard
entities.description: The shard from the Eye of Ugin's inner chamber that traveled back through time and still floats over Ugin's palm.

entities.name: The Unwritten
entities.description: A spiritual vision of the future recorded by the ancient Temur, in which the sar-khan raved of a world without dragons.

entities.name: Khanfall
entities.description: The fall of the khans after Sarkhan's changes.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane, now transformed into a world of dragonlords.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane where the Eye of Ugin lies.

events.summary: Sarkhan reflects, in flight, that everyone he knew lives changed, except himself and Narset, and resolves to ask Ugin.
events.quote: Everyone lived, it seemed, save two. Sarkhan. And Narset.

events.summary: Sarkhan sees blue-white light rise from Ugin's canyon and is harried by ghostly dragons that then retreat.
events.quote: Soon the spirit was joined by others.

events.summary: Sarkhan finds the hedron cocoon crumbled and Ugin alive, projecting images of Tarkir's dragons on the canyon wall.
events.quote: There, at the end of the canyon, a luminous shape towered, wings outstretched.

events.summary: Ugin deduces from the hedron shard that it came from the Eye after his defeat, and asks who Sarkhan is.
Sarkhan explains his history: Ugin's spirit whispered to him, Bolas sent him to the Eye, and he later traveled back in time to save Ugin.
events.quote: When I stepped through I traveled back, before the dragons died, and tipped the scales of history.

events.summary: Sarkhan names Bolas as the one who sent him to the Eye to release the Eldrazi, and Ugin contains him briefly in a sphere of force before releasing him.
events.quote: He wanted it opened, the devourers released. He never told me why.

events.summary: Ugin explains that Sarkhan's original Tarkir never existed, and that Sarkhan never was born in this history.
events.quote: you, Sarkhan Vol, stepped fully formed out of a shadow, a place that never existed.

events.summary: Ugin recounts that Sorin Markov woke him and spoke of foolishness at the Eye.
events.quote: An ally of mine, a vampire and a Planeswalker, woke me up and spoke to me of 'foolishness at the Eye.'

events.summary: Sarkhan thanks Ugin and flies off to find Narset, certain she lives again.
events.quote: I say she lives again, and I will find her.

events.summary: Sarkhan finds this timeline's Narset walking through the snow; she doesn't know him but has read secret histories about the sar-khan.
events.quote: About a dragon-man, a sar-khan, who came from something called the Unwritten

events.summary: Narset reveals she traveled beyond Tarkir; Sarkhan explains planeswalkers and that three are in the valley.
events.quote: Planeswalker," said Sarkhan. "That's what we're called.

events.summary: Narset goes to speak to Ugin and plans to study Atarka's ivory histories, content to stay on Tarkir for now; Sarkhan agrees.
events.quote: But this world has secrets enough. For right now…I'm right where I want to be.

relations.note: He saved Ugin, who now questions him.
relations.quote: You went there, traveled to Tarkir's past, and used the shard to save me.

relations.note: He wishes to be free of Bolas and make him pay.
relations.quote: To be free of him forever," said Sarkhan. "To make him pay, someday, for what he did to me.

relations.note: Bolas cast Ugin down and engineered the Eldrazi's release.
relations.quote: If he engineered the Eldrazi's release, he is far less cautious than I remember him.

relations.note: Ugin's vampire ally who woke him.
relations.quote: An ally of mine, a vampire and a Planeswalker, woke me up

relations.note: He hopes to be the friend of this Narset as he was of the other.
relations.quote: I am your friend—or was, and hope to be again.

relations.note: Branded a heretic by Ojutai's order.
relations.quote: You're not…some enforcer for the dragonlord, here to punish my heresy?
